title: The North Face Borealis Backpack (Select Colours) $127.85 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: The North Face Borealis Backpack (Select Colours) $127.85 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[XeKayeM] Had one for a little while and sent it back, they have no structure so no good as a daily commuter if thats what you need. Also with no structure, any weight you put in that front top pocket just crumples the rest of the backback.
Great if you want something just to throw a jacket in…. but if thats all you need there are probably much cheaper options.
[cbalcs] Their updated backpacks aren't like they used to be. I was in NYC, and my previous model Recon backpack was stolen. In LA, on the way home, I stopped at the outlet store and got the new Recon for $60 USD. The quality has gone down. The bottom used to be a rubberised waterproof material, and that's gone. The front pocket completely folds over itself, tipping out the contents of anything not zipped. This is my fourth Recon bag and I'd probably not buy one again. This bag also has the same front pocket.
[Broden] Is this even an everyday pack? Looks like something you would take camping or travelling.
[whey4000] Whats a good everyday backpack. Taking my work laptop on the train, normally a lunch box etc. My current bag is falling apart.
[Kabal] Not really an ozbargain but able carry 13 rules
[NedStark102] Mountain designs make some good gear for an affordable price.
[linkser] Osprey Transporter Small. Got the zip top version but there are multiple models. Doesn't look too outdoorsy, has side pockets for a small water bottle and a good stable laptop sleeve.
[CalmLemons] I used to have the old one and complained it was too rigid at the back and too heavy of the solid insert, but I guess now the alternative is worse.
[Broden] https://findyourfeet.com.au/products/fjallraven-skule-28-bac…
if you want a good backpack, this is a terrific one. One of the lightest bags of the 28L capacity out there.
[matt-ozb] 750g .. not at all the lightest. Research more. Around 400g is decent .. https://hyperlitemountaingear.com/products/summit-30
[liam2040] horses for courses … are you catching a plane or hiking for 9 hours?
[killingtime] If you want a good backpack get an Osprey
[SupeNintendoChalmers] North Face Borealis?
At this time of day!?
[JohnHowardsEyebrows] Came looking for this reference. Doubly pleased it was you who made it.
[tightm8] TNF is one of those brands that have just fallen off a cliff from a quality perspective.
[jaboday423] Any good recommendations on laptop bags which can serve as day-to-day laptop and lunch box responsibilities, but during holidays, hold as a cabin bag replacement (due to 7kg limit, required to hold laptop, iPad, some clothes)?
[paloverde88] Just fell off so we decided to take the trip
